newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas to revamp Eurocargo in N. Europe.
newsitem.headline: Danzas to revamp Eurocargo in N. Europe.

text.p: Swiss freight forwarding group Danzas AG said it was reorganising its Eurocargo division's business in northern Europe.

Danzas said in its annual report that collaboration between Danzas and nothern European agents was being reorganised to optimise Danzas's representation in that part of the continent. It gave no details.

"Across-the-board stregthening of sales activity is expected to boost sales in 1997, which -- together with lower costs as a result of optimised structures and procedures -- is expected to generate improved results," it said of Eurocargo.
Eurocargo had 1.80 billion Swiss francs in 1996 net sales, down from 1.88 billion in 1995. Total group net sales were 4.05 billion in 1996 versus 4.02 billion the year before.
